logic.note: Samples are handed to the board's I2S peripheral as whole blocks in the format the firmware configured (24-bit data left-justified in 32-bit slots, as the chip sends). BCLK / WS edges and the 'tri-state the other channel' timing are not simulated.

timing.note: Blocks are produced when the board's DMA asks for them, in virtual time; sample-accurate phase of the tone or clip is kept across blocks.

analog.note: Sound is synthetic (silence, a sine tone, deterministic noise or a PCM clip) at the set SPL, mapped with the datasheet sensitivity (-26 dBFS at 94 dB SPL). No acoustic path, frequency response, self-noise floor (61 dBA SNR) or clipping above 120 dB SPL.

power.note: 1.4 mA from VDD; off below 1.8 V.

emulates: Audio the firmware records over I2S, in the format it asked for
Left / right channel from the L/R pin
Loudness in dB SPL with the real sensitivity
doesNotEmulate: Real room sound (the browser microphone can feed the clip prop with permission)
Acoustic port, case resonance, wind noise
Start-up time (the real mic needs ~85 ms of clock before data is valid)
testOnRealDevice: Point the sound port (bottom hole) at the source through a hole in the case
Discard the first ~100 ms after starting I2S
Check the 24-bit samples are read from 32-bit slots and shifted down
